[center][size=6][b]Immersive Bath
[/b][/size]
[i]Stay clean, stay happy! A hygiene system for Stardew Valley

[/i][/center][quote]Safe to uninstall anytime. Removing it just disables the features.

[size=3][/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements][size=3]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements[/size][/url][/quote]
[size=5][b]Description[/b][/size]

Ever wondered why your farmer can work in the mines all day covered in slime and nobody bats an eye? Well, not anymore! Immersive Bath adds a cleanliness system to Stardew Valley that affects your relationships and abilities.

[b]Your cleanliness matters![/b] NPCs will notice whether you're fresh and clean or covered in dirt and grime. Stay clean to make friends easier, or embrace the dirt for combat bonuses!

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41604/41604-1769555375-1015723138.png[/img]

[line]

[size=5][b]How It Works[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Cleanliness System[/b] - Your cleanliness starts at 100% and gradually decreases over time and when using tools
[/list][list]
[*][b]Take a Bath[/b] - Use the Bath Sponge (sold at Pierre's) near any water source to clean up
[/list][list]
[*][b]Soap for Deep Clean[/b] - Attach Soap to your sponge for 100% cleanliness, or rinse without soap for 70%
[/list][list]
[*][b]Visual Feedback[/b] - On-screen UI shows your current cleanliness percentage and status
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41604/41604-1769555375-2076363494.png[/img]

[line]

[size=5][b]Cleanliness States[/b][/size]

[size=4][color=#4CAF50][b]Clean (80-100%)[/b][/color][/size]
[list]
[*]Heart buff icon appears in your buff tray
[*][b]+Luck bonus[/b] (configurable)
[*][b]+Friendship points[/b] when talking to NPCs
[*]People appreciate your hygiene!
[/list]

[size=4][color=#FFA726][b]Neutral (40-79%)[/b][/color][/size]
[list]
[*]No buffs or debuffs
[*]You're just... okay
[/list]

[size=4][color=#F44336][b]Dirty (0-39%)[/b][/color][/size]
[list]
[*]Sick face debuff icon appears in your buff tray
[*][b]+Speed, +Defense, +Attack[/b] (you're fired up!)
[*][b]-Friendship points[/b] when talking to NPCs
[*]NPCs show an angry reaction when you talk to them
[/list][list]
[*]Great for combat, bad for making friends!
[/list]
[center]﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41604/41604-1769367783-522095078.png[/img]﻿[/center]

[line]

[size=5][b]Special Features[/b][/size]

[b]Revitalized Buff[/b]
Take a bath with soap after 6 PM and wake up with a max energy bonus the next morning!

[b]Configurable Everything[/b]
[list]
[*]Adjust decay rates
[*]Change buff values
[*]Move the UI anywhere on screen
[*]Toggle features on/off
[*]Enable "Bath Anywhere" to skip the water requirement
[/list]

[b]Translation Support[/b]
All text is translatable! Community translations welcome.

[line]

[size=5][b]Items[/b][/size]

[b]Bath Sponge[/b] - 100g at Pierre's General Store
Tool with one attachment slot. Use near water to take a bath.

[b]Soap[/b] - 20g at Pierre's General Store
Attach to your sponge for a deep clean (100% cleanliness).

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41604/41604-1769367783-1192293424.png[/img]

[line]

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or higher
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional but recommended)
[/list]


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41604/41604-1769555374-1674005012.png[/img][line][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41604/41604-1769555374-46691338.png[/img]

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your Mods folder
[*]Download the buff icons from the Stardew Valley wiki:
- [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/File:Emote_Heart.png]heart_buff.png[/url] (already 16x16)
- [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/File:Emote_Sick.gif]Emote_Sick.gif[/url] (resize to 16x16, save as sick_emote.png)
[*]Place both icon files in [font=Courier New]Mods/ImmersiveBath/assets/[/font]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]

[b]See the included BUFF_ICON_INSTRUCTIONS.md for detailed icon setup steps.[/b]

[line]

[size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

Use Generic Mod Config Menu to adjust settings in-game, or edit [font=Courier New]config.json[/font]:

[list]
[*][b]UI Settings[/b] - Show/hide cleanliness display, position on screen
[*][b]Decay Settings[/b] - How fast cleanliness decreases
[*][b]Clean Buffs[/b] - Luck bonus, friendship points gained
[*][b]Dirty Buffs[/b] - Combat bonuses, friendship points lost
[*][b]Revitalized Buff[/b] - Morning energy bonus
[*][b]Bath Anywhere[/b] - Toggle water requirement
[/list]

[line]

[size=5][b]FAQ[/b][/size]

[b]Q: The buff icons are huge! What's wrong?[/b]
A: The icon files must be exactly 16x16 pixels. Check BUFF_ICON_INSTRUCTIONS.md for proper sizing.

[b]Q: Can I bathe in the spa?[/b]
A: Yes! The Bath House pool counts as a valid water source.

[b]Q: Does this work in multiplayer?[/b]
A: Yes! Each player has their own cleanliness level.

[b]Q: Can I disable the friendship penalties?[/b]
A: Yes! Set "Friendship Loss (Dirty)" to 0 in the config menu.

[b]Q: I want to bathe anywhere without needing water[/b]
A: Enable "Bath Anywhere" in the General Settings section of the config menu.

[line]

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

Should be compatible with most mods. No vanilla files are modified.


[center][b]Enjoy staying clean! (Or don't... the choice is yours!)[/b][/center]
